# ACP schema snapshots

The v1 schema is the stable `schema.json` release asset from
[`schema-v1.26.0`](https://github.com/agentclientprotocol/agent-client-protocol/releases/tag/schema-v1.26.0),
vendored on 2026-10-26. Its published SHA-256 is
`4bcd1d2051ff7ed379bd9b234fb9b09c5ab9245478698e9fab805bd9b52a33a6`.

The v2 schema is a verbatim copy of the draft `schema.unstable.json` from
`agentclientprotocol/agent-client-protocol` commit
`beac4ba96190018e9f6d82e148ff275084c5aa3e`, also vendored on 2026-10-26.

They are used only to validate ACP test fixtures. Do not hand-edit them.
